messages.subject: Kestrel - status and timetable
messages.plaintextBody:
Henry, Maya,

A quick update. The Subscription Agreement first draft has gone to Birchall Stone and we expect their mark-up next week. Birchall have started legal due diligence and have asked for the data room to be supplemented (employment and IP folders). The Investor Rights Agreement and amended Articles are in preparation.

Working timetable: documents agreed early March, disclosure letter mid-March, completion targeted for 18 March. Please keep that date free for board sign-off.

Kind regards,
Sarah
Sarah Whitfield  |  Partner

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
